destination.suggested_title: Independent Qualification of Transaction-Composed Richards Temporal Indicator History

qualification_goal: Independently verify that the F-SI25 production indicator remains numerically and physically non-interfering when its previous accepted derivative is owned, cloned, rejected, retried, rolled back and committed through the F-KT10 transaction state, without selecting or implying a scientific temporal tolerance or production acceptance policy.

required_independent_gates.G01_source_lineage_lock: Lock F-KT10 closeout/handoff, F-SI25 closeout/evidence and frozen F-VQ30 plan/evidence before execution.
required_independent_gates.G02_transaction_lifecycle: Independently verify warmup-unavailable, accepted commit, temporal rejection, solver rejection, mass rejection, retry, rollback and committed-history reuse semantics.
required_independent_gates.G03_feature_scope_and_A_B_A: Verify inactive layouts allocate no derivative vector and A-B-A execution cannot leak continuation history between columns.
required_independent_gates.G04_real_production_binding: Exercise the admitted reference-Richards production seam through F-KT10-owned history and verify physical state, accepted fluxes and mass are unchanged by history plumbing.
required_independent_gates.G05_frozen_F_VQ30_replay: Replay the frozen 16-case F-VQ30 production matrix with transaction-supplied previous history and require unchanged B_inf, hard mass and bounded-cost shape.
required_independent_gates.G06_independent_disjoint_composition_mat: Freeze before execution a composition matrix disjoint from F-KT10's single real fixture and preferably from F-SI24/F-VQ30 state-jump-time triplets; compare direct F-SI25 explicit-history evaluation against transaction-composed F-KT10 evaluation on the same physical case. This is a composition equivalence gate, not a truth/error-bound gate.
required_independent_gates.G07_bounded_cost: Require zero additional full nonlinear trajectories and at most one additional defect tridiagonal solve for indicator evaluation.
required_independent_gates.G08_hard_mass_and_noninterference: Require hard mass closure and physical state/flux identity with and without continuation plumbing in the admitted envelope.
required_independent_gates.G09_O0_O2: Require machine-readable O0/O2 identity under current convention for focused independent qualification outputs.
required_independent_gates.G10_fail_closed_policy_boundary: Verify B_inf is not populated into the F-KT09 dimensionless <=1 certificate; temporal acceptance remains unavailable/fail-closed.
required_independent_gates.G11_seed_and_continuity_boundary: Verify absent seed preserves warmup-unavailable and invalid seed fails closed. Do not qualify arbitrary restart files or forcing/event-discontinuity continuity provenance.

recommended_disjoint_matrix.comparison: direct F-SI25 production seam with explicit known previous derivative versus the same seam reached through F-KT10 transaction-owned seeded history
recommended_disjoint_matrix.pass_semantics: same B_inf/current derivative/indicator route and physical/mass/cost noninterference within strict deterministic/floating regression policy; no N512 or scientific truth comparator required

hard_holds: Do not select a scientific temporal tolerance or normalization.
Do not promote B_inf into the F-KT09 dimensionless <=1 production certificate.
Do not call B_inf a qualified general nonlinear true-error bound.
Do not introduce q_cap, Nmin, geometric-tail multipliers, fitted safety factors or deep refinement trajectories.
Do not change Richards physics, forcing, boundary semantics or mass accounting.
Do not expose HeadCalc private arrays or make solver scratch persistent per column.
Do not qualify arbitrary restart files from the optional seed seam.
Do not carry history across forcing/event/topology discontinuities unless continuity is separately established; otherwise fail closed/unavailable.
Do not release F-GC02, groundwater coupling or F-PE from this qualification alone.

success_boundary.may_qualify: independent production/composition correctness of transaction-owned indicator history in the admitted reference-Richards envelope
success_boundary.may_not_qualify: scientific temporal acceptance tolerance, general nonlinear error bound, forcing-discontinuity continuity, arbitrary restart persistence, groundwater/coupling release
success_boundary.independent_result_then_routes_to: separate scientific temporal acceptance/normalization work before the existing F-GC02 can be resumed
